claims: Autumn Durald Arkapaw won the 2026 Oscar for Best Cinematography for Sinners.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first woman to win the Oscar for Best Cinematography.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first Black person to win the Oscar for Best Cinematography.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Cinematography for Sinners.
Michael Bauman was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Cinematography for One Battle After Another.
Dan Laustsen was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Cinematography for Frankenstein.
Darius Khondji was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Cinematography for Marty Supreme.
Adolpho Veloso was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Cinematography for Train Dreams.
The 98th Academy Awards highlighted Sinners for its distinctive visual style.
Frankenstein was noted for extensive wide-angle shots.
Marty Supreme was noted for its dynamic, fast-paced imagery.
